question: Should CodexBar preserve and actively use legacy DeepSeek Platform tokens stored in `cookieHeader`, or migrate them out and require live Chrome-session discovery?
rationale: The branch deliberately preserves this credential for compatibility, but the linked source PR states that Platform tokens remain in memory and legacy values are removed; repository intent is required to define the security and upgrade contract.

options.title: Remove persisted legacy tokens
options.body: Normalize away DeepSeek `cookieHeader` and rely on live Chrome discovery, with focused migration tests and browser-only proof.

options.title: Keep compatibility path
options.body: Retain legacy stored tokens only with explicit documentation, upgrade tests, and proof that credential and account scoping is safe.

recommendation.title: Remove persisted legacy tokens
recommendation.body: Normalize away DeepSeek `cookieHeader` and rely on live Chrome discovery, with focused migration tests and browser-only proof.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the strongest available owner for credential persistence and upgrade policy.
